test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Correct the underlined part of the sentence.

 The rabbit runs __fastly__
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. fast .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of using an** adverb** to describe the verb **"runs."**
 
• The correct form of the adverb "fast" does not take a comparative or superlative form in this context.
 
• "Fastly" is incorrect as "fast" itself is both an adjective and an adverb.

Correct sentence: *The rabbit runs **fast***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverbs of Manner:**

 
 
• **Example:** He sings beautifully.
 
• **Note:** Adverbs like "quickly," "slowly," "carefully" typically end in "-ly", but some adverbs like "fast," "hard," "early," "late" do not.
